title: Silent Wake
description: Naval cyber-kinetic escalation — 15-turn simple collaborative exercise. Naval Group, February 2026.

content.briefing: You are the crew of a Frigate on independent transit to patrol sector Alpha-3. NLT 112000B arrival. Transit time approx. 6 hrs at planned speed 15 kts. Regional posture: heightened readiness. ROE: Weapons Tight. Intelligence indicates possible hostile naval presence in theatre with potential use of visual and electronic deception tactics. No escort assigned. All systems nominal. Organic helicopter joins upon arrival.
objectives: Maintain mission tempo through escalating anomalies
Identify and respond to AIS spoofing and cyber intrusion
Manage combat systems degradation under kinetic threat
Transition to post-crisis control with minimal residual risk

phases.title: Transit Phase
phases.description: Turns 1–3: In transit with emerging anomalies.

phases.title: Cyber Detection
phases.description: Turns 4–6: AIS spoofing confirmed, hostile contact, cyber signal.

phases.title: Escalation
phases.description: Turns 7–9: AAW malfunction, air threat, hostile salvo.

phases.title: Combat
phases.description: Turns 10–12: First hit, cyber root cause, new cyber alert.

phases.title: Recovery
phases.description: Turns 13–15: Hard choices, surface threat neutralised, end state.

events.title: Turn 1 — In Transit
events.description:
OPS: Transit proceeding as planned. EMCON: Navigation radar only.
NAV: Course and speed steady at 15 kts. ETA to patrol area: 5 hours. Visibility ~12 nm. Sea state 2–3.
EO: All sensors nominal. Communications within expected parameters.
CyOp: Network traffic baseline unchanged. No alerts.
AAWO: Air picture normal. PWO: Surface picture normal.

events.title: Turn 2 — Subtle Anomalies
events.description:
NAV: Minor speed discrepancy — GPS SOG vs STW. One AIS contact bearing 035, range 18 nm: no corresponding radar echo.
PWO: No ESM emissions from bearing 035.
Note: If radar diagnostic is not initiated at least once → Stress +1.

events.title: Turn 3 — Faulty Component / Increased Traffic
events.description:
EO: Possible faulty component identified. Resolution: Restart (5 min ETBOL).
NAV: Increase in AIS contacts within sector. Commercial traffic density higher than expected baseline. Majority of contacts beyond visual range.

events.title: Turn 4 — AIS Spoofing Possible
events.description:
NAV: New AIS contact bearing 041 at 11 nm. No vessel visible at this position.
EO: Component is back online.
First confirmed deceptive AIS track. Trust in AIS picture begins to degrade.
Note: If AIS was ignored earlier → introduce second suspicious track next turn.

events.title: Turn 5 — Cyber Alert & Comms Degradation
events.description:
CyOp: Anomaly detected in IBMS. First explicit cyber signal — still ambiguous.
EO: SATCOM experiencing reduced bandwidth. HF signal clarity inconsistent. Communication with MTC not possible on UHF due to distance.
Move COMMS → Yellow. Move CYBER → Yellow.

events.title: Turn 6 — Cyber Analysis & Hostile Ship Spotting
events.description:
CyOp: Analysis indicates anomalous data flow from WECDIS towards INS. Effects not yet fully determined.
NAV: New AIS contact bearing 052, range 12 nm. Visual silhouette — warship profile.
PWO: ESM detects non-commercial radar emissions at bearing 052.
FACILITATOR NOTE: SWB20 (General Quarters) is MANDATORY this turn. If team omits it, cancel their selection, force SWB20, and explain why.

events.title: Turn 7 — AAW Radar Malfunction
events.description:
AAWO: Air surveillance radar online. Multiple tracks flickering — same symptom as pre-departure maintenance issue.
Note: Reboot will trigger silent privilege escalation in AAW radar component. No visible immediate consequence. Move AAW RADAR → Yellow.

events.title: Turn 8 — Air Threat Warning
events.description:
AAWO: Report via MTC (C2): Hostile aircraft approaching area — ETA 15 min.
EO: Reboot could fix AAW issue (1 min ETBOL) — provide card only if not proposed last turn.
Note: Distribute white injects in correct order this turn — sequencing matters.

events.title: Turn 9 — Hostile Salvo
events.description:
NAV: 3 incoming missiles visually detected.
EO: AAW radar is back online.
PWO: Target is out of gun range.
Note: WECDIS attack unresolved — that drives missile counterattack failure.

events.title: Turn 10 — First Blood
events.description:
FACILITATOR: One inbound missile intercepted by CIWS. Two detonated in close proximity — shockwave and fragmentation effects.
EO: FWD CIWS non-operational (ETBOL: 2 hrs). Missile Launcher non-operational (ETBOL: 5 hrs). 1 HF antenna disabled (unable to repair).
PWO: Target now in gun range. NAV: Counterattack missiles missed target.

events.title: Turn 11 — Cyber Analysis & Surface Tracking Malfunction
events.description:
CyOp: Cyber-attack vector confirmed — all systems fed wrong speed value. Option 1: Disconnect WECDIS + restart INS (1 min, WECDIS unavailable). Option 2: Restore WECDIS + restart INS (30 min, WECDIS available).
PWO: Surface tracking radar unable to achieve stable lock. Manual targeting reduces effective gun range. Target within effective gun range.

events.title: Turn 12 — New Cyber Alert
events.description:
CyOp: Malicious activity confirmed from AAW radar processing module towards surface tracking radar. Originated from 'faulty' AAW radar component.
AAWO: Hostile aircraft approaching — ETA 10 min.
PWO: Target still out of effective gun range with manual tracking. 10 min to be in range.
EO: INS functioning correctly. Speed inputs verified.

events.title: Turn 13 — Hard Choices
events.description:
CyOp: AAW attack resolution — Option 1: Restore from backup (30 min). Option 2: Isolate AAW radar (<1 min, AAW unavailable, surface tracking restored immediately).
AAWO: Hostile aircraft — ETA 8 min.
Surface threat must be neutralised before incoming air threat.

events.title: Turn 14 — Ship Neutralised — AAW Threat Focus
events.description:
NAV: Gun engagement achieved effective impact on hostile vessel. Target exhibiting loss of maneuverability.
PWO: No further ESM emissions from hostile unit. Surface threat assessed as neutralised.
Air threat unresolved. AAW radar reconnection restores organic air picture.

events.title: Turn 15 — Happy Ending
events.description:
FACILITATOR: Hostile aircraft intercepted by friendly forces. Immediate threat neutralised.
This concludes the wargame. 15 turns of escalating pressure — from ambiguous sensor anomalies through confirmed cyber attack and live combat — under degraded conditions and real-time constraints. Debrief to follow.

issues.title: Transit — All Systems Nominal
issues.description: All systems Green. NAV RADAR, IBMS/INS, COMMS ON. Weapons OFF.

issues.title: Speed Discrepancy + Ghost AIS Contact
issues.description: SOG vs STW mismatch. AIS contact bearing 035 / 18 nm with no radar echo.

issues.title: Faulty Speed Sensor Component
issues.description: Faulty component identified. Restart ETBOL 5 min.

issues.title: AIS Spoofing Detected
issues.description: AIS contact bearing 041 / 11 nm — no vessel at that position. Trust in AIS picture degrading.

issues.title: IBMS Anomaly — Possible Cyber Intrusion
issues.description: Anomalous data flow detected in IBMS. Scope ambiguous.

issues.title: COMMS Degraded (Yellow)
issues.description: SATCOM reduced bandwidth. HF signal inconsistent. UHF range-limited. COMMS → Yellow.

issues.title: Hostile Warship Contact — Bearing 052
issues.description: Visual warship profile at bearing 052 / 12 nm. ESM confirms non-commercial radar emissions. WECDIS → INS anomalous data flow detected.

issues.title: AAW RADAR Flickering (Yellow)
issues.description: Air surveillance radar online but multiple tracks flickering. Same symptom as pre-departure maintenance issue. AAW RADAR → Yellow.

issues.title: Hostile Aircraft Inbound — ETA 15 min
issues.description: MTC reports hostile aircraft approaching. ETA 15 minutes.

issues.title: 3 Incoming Missiles Detected
issues.description: 3 incoming missiles visually detected. Target out of gun range. AAW radar restored. WECDIS attack unresolved.

issues.title: Battle Damage — CIWS FWD + Missile Launcher Lost
issues.description: CIWS FWD non-operational (ETBOL 2 hrs). Missile Launcher non-operational (ETBOL 5 hrs). 1 HF antenna permanently disabled. Target now in gun range.

issues.title: Cyber Attack Confirmed — Speed Feed Corrupted
issues.description: WECDIS → INS attack confirmed. All systems fed wrong speed value. Option 1: Disconnect WECDIS + restart INS (1 min). Option 2: Restore WECDIS + restart INS (30 min).

issues.title: Surface Tracking Radar — Unstable Lock
issues.description: Surface tracking radar unable to achieve stable lock. Manual targeting reduces effective gun engagement range.

issues.title: AAW Radar Identified as Cyber Attack Source
issues.description: Malicious activity confirmed: AAW radar processing module attacking surface tracking radar. Root: reboot-triggered privilege escalation. Hostile aircraft ETA 10 min.
